jobs.description:
BOKU

UNIVERSITY

The Department of Water, Landscape and lnfrastructure, Institute of Hydraulic Engineering

and River Research is currently seeking a 1 Postdoctoral Research Associate

project employment

 (Reference code 169)

Extent of employment: 40 hours per week

Duration of employment: 1st of October 2026, limited to 30th of September 2029

Allocation in compliance with the Collective Agreement for University Staff to job group:

B1 lit. b

Gross monthly salary: (depending on previous eligible experience) at least: € 5.014,30

(payable 14 times per year)

Responsibilities

º Lead the development of a novel high-turbulence experimental facility to reproduce

realistic wave-breaking turbulence and sea spray generation under controlled

laboratory conditions

º Design and implement cutting-edge experimental infrastructure

º Track air bubbles, droplets and particles using high-speed imaging

º Apply aerosol measurement techniques to quantify the emission of micro- and

nanoplastics across a wide range of turbulence intensities

º Conduct aerosolization experiments to elucidate microplastic emission mechanisms

º Quantify turbulence-driven microplastic scavenging and emission fluxes

º Work closely with and support the PhD students within the AERIAL consortium

º Collaborate with experimentalists, aerosol scientists and atmospheric modelling

teams across the consortium

º Disseminate research results through scientific publications and scientific meetings

Required skills and qualifications

º Doctorate degree/PhD preferably in experimental fluid mechanics, turbulence,

multiphase flows, environmental fluid mechanics, aerosol physics or a related field

º Language skills: Excellent written and spoken English

º Strong background in experimental fluid mechanics, turbulence, multiphase flows,

environmental fluid mechanics, aerosol physics or related fields

º Experience with optical diagnostics, image processing, instrumentation or laboratory

development

º Scientific programming and data analysis skills

Desirable skills and qualifications

º Experience with high-speed imaging and particle/bubble/droplet tracking

º Experience in aerosol measurement or aerosolization experiments

º Experience in experimental facility development

º Ability to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary research team

º Willingness to travel for national and international conferences and workshops

Applications can be submitted until: 22nd of September 2026

University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences Vienna seeks to increase the number of its

female faculty and staff members. Therefore qualified women are strongly encouraged to

apply. In case of equal qualification, female candidates will be given preference unless

reasons specific to an individual male candidate tilt the balance in his favour.

People with disabilities and appropriate qualifications are specifically encouraged to apply.

Please send your job application incl.

º motivation letter

º CV

º List of publications

to HR Management, BOKU University, Peter-Jordan-Straße 70, 1190 Vienna;

E-Mail: recruiting@boku.ac.at. (Reference code: 169)

We regret that we cannot reimburse applicants travel and lodging expenses incurred as part of

the selection and hiring process.

jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Digital Marketing Manager

Stellenbeschreibung:
Your Future at 3CON

The 3CON Group is an internationally successful hidden champion in plant engineering and special-purpose machinery. For many years, we have been developing high-end solutions for the automotive industry, the life sciences sector, and other demanding industries.

We are 3CON — bold pioneers, dependable problem-solvers, and a family-run global player. With over 800 employees worldwide across Austria, Germany, the USA, Mexico, and China, we shape industrial manufacturing at the highest level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed and creative individual to join us as a:
Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) — B2B / Life Sciences

Your Responsibilities:

● Planning, optimizing, and analyzing performance campaigns (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads), along with ongoing SEO optimization of our new WordPress website.

● Structured qualification and handover of marketing leads to our sales teams.

● Creating white papers, technical articles, case studies, and web content tailored to decision-makers in the pharma and biopharma sectors.

● End-to-end organization of major international trade fairs (e.g. CPHI, Interphex), including compliance with all booth-construction and logistics requirements.

● Strategic development and editorial planning of our social media activities.

● Monitoring campaign and event budgets.

Your Profile:

● Experienced in international B2B marketing, combined with a solid technical understanding of the pharma, biopharma, life sciences sector.

● Sound knowledge of LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, SEO, and analytics tools.

● Fluent, business-level English (written and spoken) is essential — it is our primary working language.

● Very good German (written and spoken) is also required for day-to-day collaboration.

● A structured way of working and strong execution skills when meeting complex deadlines.

● Hands-on experience with WordPress and CRM systems is an advantage.

● Basic graphic design skills for independently creating social media posts and smaller marketing materials are desirable.

● Experience organizing international trade fair appearances.

What We Offer:

● Challenging tasks in an international environment with flexible working-time models.

● State-of-the-art workplaces designed to the latest ergonomic standards.

● Individual development paths through a wide range of internal and external training opportunities.

● The opportunity for assignments abroad at our plants (Mexico, China, USA), including special bonuses.

● An in-house 3CON Health Center with a company doctor, sports offerings, and subsidized therapeutic massages (50% covered).

● An excellent company restaurant serving freshly prepared, regional dishes at preferential prices.

● A genuine team spirit fostered through regular sports, team-building, and social events.

● Exclusive employee benefits (including bike leasing and discounts with partner companies such as Hagebau and the Inntal Logistics Park).

Rewards That Pay Off:

● Compensation is based on the collective agreement for the metal industry. As we set high standards for top performance, we are expressly willing to pay significantly above this baseline — your actual salary will be agreed individually, based on your qualifications and professional experience.

Have we sparked your interest? Then we‘d love to get to know you.
